reviews.decision_reason: select_demand preserves all eight supplied needs with their record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields. The selection threshold does not drop any observed records in this package, so it is not the source of the behavioral reversal seen later.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve supplied demand records for downstream recommendation
avoid introducing unrelated or generic demand candidates

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence reindexes to the required columns, retains the allowed supplied record IDs, and returns the same eight market-demand records. No evidence here shows a demand-support defect or handoff corruption.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve the selected demand records and required fields
filter only to explicitly allowed supplied record IDs

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance reverses the evidence ranking. Its input contains demand_score 9 for n06-r01 through demand_score 3 for n06-r08, but the produced evidence_sources rank n06-r08 first and n06-r01 last. The localized cause is the sort expression using key (-demand_score, record_id) together with reverse=True, which inverts the intended demand-priority order and changes the downstream deterministic recommendation toward the lower-demand unsupported need n06-r07.
